lesson: Identify broom, dustpan and all blocks; choose handle grasps from current RGB.

Pick broom with left arm; handover to right using current receiver_grasp feature. If direct handover is infeasible, explicitly place broom on support, withdraw/home empty left, then reidentify and pick with right (reference observed table-mediated recovery).
Pick dustpan with left; hold its entry at block/table level, not above the blocks.

For each live block group choose stroke: source=broom with actual brush contact feature; destination=path with start behind the group and end inside the dustpan. Local tools triangulate these coarse semantic features and execute the stroke.
Inspect remaining blocks and dustpan contents. Replan a different stroke for residual blocks.
Place dustpan level on table left of broom, release tool(s), withdraw and home empty arms.
